name: 3rd Company Tactical Squad
Text: While you control no support cards this unit gains 1 command icon. Interrupt: When this unit leaves play, Rally 6 a support card, add it to your hand.

name: Accelerated Gestation
Text: Action: Reveal a facedown card you control attached to a unit. If it's a unit, deploy it at this planet and deal 1 unpreventable damage to attached unit (Max 1 per round).

name: Access to the Black Library
Text: Deploy Action: Search your deck for 2 cards with a different name. Reveal them, have your opponent chooses one, add it to your hand, and shuffle the remaining card in your deck.

name: Acquisition Phalanx
Text: Reaction: After a unit you control moves to this planet, this unit gets +1 ATK and +1 HP until the end of the phase.

name: Adraci-strain Broodlord
Text: Reaction: After you infest a planet, draw a card and infest an adjacent planet. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Advocator of Blood
Text: Brutal. While any warlord is bloodied, this unit gains 1 command icon. Reaction: After this unit enters play, move up to 2 damage from Chaos army units and Khorne units to this unit.

name: Attuned Gyrinx
Text: Attach to your warlord. Attached unit gets +1 HP. Combat Action: Exhaust this attachment to give a non-Elite army unit you control at each adjacent planet +1 ATK and +1 HP until the end of the phase.

name: Banner of the Cult
Text: Attach to an army unit you control. Interrupt: When attached unit leaves play, exhaust a target enemy army unit at this planet and return this card to your hand.

name: Breach and Clear
Text: If all effects of the event are cancelled, gain 2 resources.                  Exhaust an army unit. Then you may sacrifice an attachment to exhaust another target army unit at the same planet.

name: Chapter Champion Varn
Text: Reduce by 1 the cost of the first support you deploy each round. If a support you control has more damage on it than its cost, sacrifice it. Forced Interrupt: When an army unit you control takes damage equal or lower than its remaining HP, move 1 of that damage to a support card you control.

name: Citadel of Vamii
Text: Cannot be targeted by card abilities. For the purpose of card effects, this card is considered to have a cost of 4. Reaction: After a support card enters play, treats its textbox as blank until the end of the round and remove 1 damage from a support card.

name: Close Quarters Doctrine
Text: Attach to a planet. Limit 1 per planet. Each unit with a printed cost 3 or higher at this planet gets -1 ATK. Reaction: After a battle ends at this planet, draw a card.

name: Command Bravestorm
Text: Reaction: After you attach a non-Drone attachment to a unit at this planet, draw a card. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Command Predator
Text: No Wargear attachments. Reaction: After a combat turn during which this unit was an attacker ends, take a combat turn. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Connoisseur of Terror
Text: Reaction: After this unit is turned face-up, draw 2 cards.

name: Convent Prioris Advisor
Text: Reaction: After a Vostroya unit moves to a planet, place 1 F on it. Then you may sacrifice this support to place 1 F on that unit and Rally 6 a support, add it to your hand.

name: Data Analyzer
Text: Attach to an army unit. Attached unit gets +1 HP. Interrupt: When a unit is assigned damage by an attack at this planet, reassign 1 of that damage to another unit controlled by the same player at this planet.

name: Departmento Munitorum Aid
Text: Attach to a Vehicle army unit. Attached unit gets +1 HP. Action: Exhaust this attachment and remove 1 damage from attached unit to retreat it.

name: Drammask Nane
Text: Reaction: After you play a Ritual event, sacrifice a unit at this planet to have up to 4 units you control at this planet get +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

name: Drifting Spore Mines
Text: Forced Reaction: After the combat phase begins, your opponent moves this unit to an adjacent planet. Then you may deal 1 damage to this unit to deal 1 damage to a non-unique unit at that planet.

name: Emergent Cultists
Text: While this unit is at an infested planet, it gets +1 HP. Reaction: After you deploy this unit, exhaust a target enemy support.

name: Endless Legions
Text: Reaction: After a N unit enters your discard pile from play, exhaust this support and place 2 units from your discard pile at the bottom of your deck to Rally 6 a N unit with a printed cost of 3 or lower, put it into play at a target planet.

name: Escort Drone
Text: You may deploy this card as Wargear attachment with the text: Attach to an army unit. Attached unit gets +2 ATK and +1 HP. Interrupt: When attached unit leaves play, detach this card to have it become an army unit.

name: Expendable Pawn
Text: Reaction: After a unit is assigned damage at this planet or an adjacent planet, sacrifice this unit to prevent 2 of that damage.

name: Fairly Quipped Kommando
Text: This unit gets +1 HP per attachment on it. Interrupt: When an attachmement leaves play from this planet, return it to your hand instead.

name: First Dawn
Text: You may play this card from your card collection as if it were in your hand (Max 1 per trigger).                 Reaction: After another player plays a card named Bonesinger Choir, Squiggoth Brute, Corrupted Teleportarium, Gun Drones, Archon's Palace, or Land Speeder Vengeance, gain 2 resources and draw 2 cards.

name: Fortress of Mangeras
Text: Cannot be targeted by card abilities. For the purpose of card effects, this card is considered to have a cost of 4. Reaction: After a support card you control leaves play, draw a card.

name: Frontline Counsellor
Text: Interrupt: When a unit you control is routed or moves from a planet, move this unit to that planet. (Limit once per phase.) Forced Reaction: After this unit resolves its attack, move it to your HQ.

name: Fusion Cascade Defiance
Text: Attach to an army unit.                 Attached unit gets +1 ATK and +1 HP.                 Reaction: After this unit enters or leaves play, deal 1 damage to a target unit at this planet.

name: Galvax the Bloated
Text: This unit gets +1 ATK and +1 HP for each Cultist unit you control at this planet. Reaction: After a Cultist unit you control leaves play from this planet, deal 1 damage to a unit at this planet.

name: Genestealer Hybrids
Text: Cannot be deployed from your hand.                 Each other unit you control at this planet cannot be damaged by Area Effect. This unit must be declared as a defender, if able.

name: Goliath Rockgrinder
Text: While at an infested planet this unit gets +2 HP. Reaction: After this unit destroys an enemy unit, put X Termagant tokens into play at this planet. X is printed HP value of that enemy unit. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Growing Genestealer Brood
Text: Reaction: After this unit enters play, put a Brood unit into play from your discard pile at this planet.

name: Growing Tide
Text: Cannot retreat. Interrupt: When this unit leaves the first planet, move it to an adjacent planet to remove all damage from it and give it +1 ATK and +1 HP until the end of the game instead.

name: Holy Battery
Text: While at a planet with a unit with faith you control, this unit gets +1 ATK.                 Reaction: After you play a shield on this unit, place 1 faith on it.

name: Host of the Emissary
Text: Reaction: After your opponent wins a battle, exhaust this support to have your opponent sacrifice an army unit at that planet, if able.

name: Imperial Bastion
Text: Your warlord's ability can trigger twice per round instead of once. Combat Action: Exhaust this support to deal 1 damage to a unit with a facedown attached card.

name: Impulsive Loota
Text: Reaction: After an attachment card is discarded, Deep Strike this unit to deploy that attachment from your discard pile attached to this unit.

name: Ireful Vanguard
Text: While any warlord is bloodied, this unit gets +1 ATK and +1 HP. Action: Deal 3 damage to an army unit at this planet. Play this ability only if your opponent won a command struggle at this planet this round. (Limit once per round.)

name: Krieg Armoured Regiment
Text: Reaction: After this unit leaves play, place it at the bottom of your deck to Rally 6 a Tank, Vehicle or Krieg unit with a different name, put it into play at the same planet.

name: Magus Harid
Text: Reaction: After an enemy unit enters play, put a card from your hand attached facedown to that unit. Then draw a card. (Limit once per round.) As an interrupt when the attached unit leaves play, you may deploy the facedown card at the same planet.

name: Masters of the Webway
Text: Reaction: After the deploy phase begins, sacrifice this support to have each player exchange their command dial value the next time they reveal their command dial this round.

name: Memories of Fallen Comrades
Text: Attach to your warlord. Attached unit gets +1 HP. Combat Action: Exhaust this attachment to remove 1 damage from up to 2 support cards you control.

name: Morkanaut Rekuperator
Text: Reaction: After this unit resolves its attack, deal 1 unpreventable damage to a unit at this planet. If that unit is destroyed by this effect, Rally 6 an attachment card, attach it to this unit.

name: Overrun
Text: If all effects of this event are cancelled, draw 2 cards.                 Action: Exhaust a target army unit. Then, you may sacrifice a unit to rout it.

name: Phantasmatic Masque
Text: This unit gets +1 ATK for each remaining HP. Reaction: After an attack against this unit resolves, exhaust this unit to deal 2 damage to the attacker. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Positional Relay
Text: Attach to an army unit. Attached unit gets +1 ATK and +1 HP. Action: Exhaust this attachment to rally X an attachment, add it to your hand. X equals the number of attachments you control.

name: Raving Cryptek
Text: To deploy a unit at this planet, your opponent must reveal two units he can deploy from his hand. Choose one, its cost is increased by 2. Then your opponent decides which of those units to deploy.

name: Reign of Solmenance
Text: Each army unit you control at a planet with your Warlord gets +1 HP.

name: Sacrificial Altar
Text: Deploy Action: Exhaust this support and target a non first-planet to draw 1 card and gain 1 R. If your opponent wins a command struggle at the targeted planet this round, they draw 1 card and gain 1 R.

name: Scavenging Kroot Rider
Text: Reaction: After this unit enters play, attach an eligible attachment from your discard pile to this unit and exhaust a target enemy limited support card.

name: Shedding Hive Crone
Text: Reaction: After an attack resolved by this unit against an army unit doesn't destroy it, put 3 Termagant tokens into play at this planet. If the planet is infested, put 4 tokens instead.

name: Siege Masters
Text: The effects of this event cannot be cancelled. Action: Exhaust an enemy target support card and Rally 8 a support card, add it to your hand.

name: Slave-powered Wagons
Text: Action: Destroy a target token unit at this planet or an adjacent planet. Then this unit gets +1 ATK and +1 HP until the end of the phase. (Limit once per round.)

name: Starmist Raiment
Text: Attach to a Harlequin unit you control. Interrupt: When damage is assigned to a Harlequin unit you control at this planet, exhaust this attachment to reassign 1 of that damage to another non-warlord unit at this planet.

name: Surrogate Host
Text: Interrupt: When a unit you control is destroyed, move your Warlord to the same planet.

name: Talisman of Denial
Text: Attach to your warlord. Attached unit gains 3 command icons. Combat Action: Sacrifice this attachment to switch the damage on your warlord with the damage on a hale warlord at this planet.

name: The Blinded Princess
Text: Forced Reaction: After this unit enters play, your opponent may exhaust a unit at a planet to move this unit to that planet.

name: The Blood Pits
Text: Reaction: After your warlord commits to a planet with an enemy warlord, choose up to 1 enemy unit at each planet without a Warlord. Deal 2 damage to each chosen unit.

name: The Dance Without End
Text: Reaction: After a Harlequin unit enters your discard pile from a planet, return it to your hand to deploy a Harlequin unit with a different name at the same planet.

name: The Dawnsinger
Text: Reaction: After this unit is destroyed, your opponent must choose to either put 2 card from his hand on top of his deck or you draw 2 cards.

name: The Grand Plan
Text: Interrupt: When a player places a planet in their victory display, sacrifice an army unit at a planet with no enemy army unit to remove that planet from the game instead. At the end of the next round, place the planet in that player's victory display and draw 4 cards.

name: The Inevitable Decay
Text: Reaction: After an army unit enters play or moves to a planet with a unique unit you control, exhaust it and move up to 2 damage from units at the same planet to that unit.

name: The Orgiastic Feast
Text: Command Action: Rally 12 up to two units with cost 4 or lower, put them into play at a target planet and shuffle your deck. If those units are still in play at the end of the round, return them to your hand.

name: The Sun Prince
Text: Interrupt: When this unit leaves play from a planet, your opponent must choose, at the same planet, either to exhaust a unit he controls or ready a unit you control.

name: The Webway Witch
Text: Reaction: After you deploy this unit, the next time your opponent deploys a unit this phase, he must deploy it at this planet, if able.

name: Third Eye of Trazyn
Text: Attach to your warlord. Attached unit gets +1 HP. Combat Reaction: After your Warlord moves to a planet, exhaust this attachment to move an army unit you control at that planet to an adjacent planet.

name: Tides of Chaos
Text: Reaction: After your warlord commits to a planet, until the end of the phase, each army unit gains an amount of command icons equal to their ATK value.

name: Trazyn the Infinite
Text: Interrupt: When your Warlord would be defeated, move it to a target planet to remove all the damage from it instead.

name: Triarch Stalkers Procession
Text: No Wargear attachments. Forced Reaction: After you deploy this unit, have your opponent draw 2 cards.

name: Triumvirate of Ynnead
Text: This event cannot be cancelled. Action: Deploy 2 non-Elite units with a different name from your discard pile at 2 different planets. Reduce their cost by 1.

name: Uncontrollable Rioters
Text: Cost of units you deploy is increased by 1. This unit cannot change control more than once per round. Action: Give control of this unit to your opponent.

name: Vael the Gifted
Text: The effects of Ritual events you play cannot be cancelled. When the first round starts, remove each Ritual card in your deck from the game. You may play Ritual events you removed from the game as if they were in your hand. (Limit once per round.)

name: Vale Tenndrac
Text: Reaction: After this unit enters play, put 1 Termagant token into play at this planet and each adjacent infested planet. Interrupt: When your opponent triggers an ability that discards a card from your hand, put this unit into play at a planet to draw two cards.

name: Warhost Helmet
Text: Attach to a Saim-Hann unit. Limit 1 per unit.                 Attached unit gets +2 HP. Reaction: After attached unit is assigned damage, exhaust it and this attachment to prevent all of that damage. Then attached unit gets +1 ATK for its next attack this phase.

name: Willing Submission
Text: Forced Reaction: After the deploy phase begins, draw 1 card. Then your opponent may choose 2 units he controls (or his warlord if he controls no other unit) to draw 1 card. You may deal 1 damage to one of the chosen units.

name: Yvraine
Text: You cannot include [Chaos] Elite units. Reaction: After this unit commits to a planet, a non-Elite army unit you control at an adjacent planet is considered to be a warlord while checking for a battle at that planet this round.

name: Yvraine's Entourage
Text: Reaction: After a battle begins at this planet, switch the printed ATK values of two army units at this planet until the end of a combat round.

name: Zen 'Xi' Aonia
Text: Each enemy unit at this planet loses the Area Effect keyword. Forced Interrupt: When an unit you control at this planet is chosen as a defender, declare another eligible unit as the defender instead, if able.
